findings.current: My very first strike had gone straight for the area around his heart.
findings.defect: “Gone straight for” describes the strike’s aim, not its successful penetration.
findings.rationale: 파고들었다 says the blow drove into the area around his heart.
findings.replacement: My very first strike had pierced the area around his heart.
findings.source: 가장 처음의 일격은 심장 어림을 정확히 파고들었다.

findings.defect: “Consumable” does not convey that the item can be used only once.
The insult is softened, blunting Jin’s hostile address.
findings.rationale: 새끼 is a forceful insult directed at the person he is confronting.

findings.current: The Grand Mage, who had weathered the Great Cataclysm with his whole body, couldn’t hold back a groan.
findings.defect: “Weathered ... with his whole body” is an unnatural literal rendering.
findings.rationale: 온몸으로 헤쳐나온 emphasizes that he endured the catastrophe himself.
findings.replacement: The Grand Mage, who had lived through the Great Cataclysm firsthand, couldn’t hold back a groan.
findings.source: 대격변이라는 파도를 온몸으로 헤쳐나온 대마도사는 참지 못하고 신음을 흘렸다.

findings.current: Unlike the other humans, he was quick to calculate.
findings.defect: “Quick to calculate” sounds like doing arithmetic rather than rapidly assessing his situation.
findings.rationale: 계산이 빨랐어 describes Michael’s fast, self-interested judgment before he surrendered.
findings.replacement: Unlike the other humans, he was quick to size up the situation.
findings.source: 다른 인간들과는 달리 녀석은 계산이 빨랐어.

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it changes whether the first strike landed and loses the item’s single-use limit. Several lines also soften or obscure the source.
